text:
jordan (People Ops): Hey @maria — Mia returned from her 12-week sabbatical today and pinged me. Her paystub for the return payrun shows a PTO payout + a noticeably higher federal withholding than usual. Can payroll check whether the sabbatical payout triggered a supplemental rate or was withheld twice?

maria (Payroll): Thanks @jordan. Can you paste the paystub snippet or the last 4 of Mia's SSN and the pay period so I can pull the record?

jordan (People Ops): attaching snippet inline: 
```
Gross: $4,200.00
PTO payout: $1,800.00
Federal Tax: $1,290.00 (≈30.7%)
Net: $2,050.00
```
Employee: Mia Torres, EmpID 45912, last4 SSN 6789, pay period 03/01–03/15

kevin (Eng Manager): Mia told me she coded the time as SB-PTO but did not opt into any voluntary tax boost. She was expecting normal withholding.

maria (Payroll): @payroll-bot fetch payrun for EmpID 45912, period 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-15 please.

payroll-bot: Fetching payrun 2026-03-15 for EmpID 45912... Found payrun. PTO coded SB-PTO. System applied supplemental flat rate (22%) for lump-sum payouts PLUS regular withholding on the remaining taxable earnings — looks like both were applied and increased effective percentage. Creating ticket PAY-4721 for manual review and potential off-cycle correction.

jordan (People Ops): Thanks. Do we need Mia's consent to run an off-cycle correction? She'd like net fixed asap.

maria (Payroll): For a clear payroll processing error we do not need employee consent to run a corrective off-cycle. ETA for correction: up to 3 business days from ticket triage. We'll include an explanatory note and update YTD.

kevin (Eng Manager): Important: will this change the YTD federal withholding that ends up on her W-2? If so, we should let payroll know so we can communicate to Mia ahead of year-end.

maria (Payroll): Yes — reversing an incorrect withholding will adjust YTD amounts. If we issue the reversal this month we'll update the payroll ledger and the W-2 feed accordingly. Ticket PAY-4721 will track the W-2 impact.

jordan (People Ops): Awesome — I'll message Mia with the ETA and link to the ticket. Please cc me and Kevin on updates. :thumbsup:

maria (Payroll): Will do. If you get any further docs (screenshot of stub with redactions) drop them here and I'll attach to the ticket.

kevin (Eng Manager): Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround.

(reacts: :eyes: from maria, :thumbsup: from kevin)
